{{Top|leg}}
The '''Landing union chapter''' was the main headquarters of the [[Sailor's Union]] of the planet [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]]. It was located in [[Farsands]], the capital city of the sovereign island of [[Little Mon Cal]], although the Union did have smaller union halls in other cities.

The Landing union chapter was managed by the shipping manager [[Kurline (Quarren)|Kurline]], a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] of ambiguous morality who fought for the Union's interests despite occasionally accepting bribes.

Farsands had a problem of corruption and some workers complained that the Union, through their main offices, was threatening them.
